mapper.select: SELECT su.ID AS userId, su.`NAME` AS userName, su.TENANT_ID AS tenantId, su.ORG_ID AS orgId, so.`NAME` as orgName, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'holidayBalanceId', hb.ID, 'holidayTypeId', hb.HOLIDAY_TYPE_ID, 'holidayName', hr.HOLIDAY_NAME, 'balance', hb.BALANCE ) ) AS holidayDetails FROM OA_ATTN_HOLIDAY_BALANCE hb JOIN OA_ATTN_HOLIDAY_RULE hr ON hb.HOLIDAY_TYPE_ID = hr.ID JOIN SYS_USER su ON hb.USER_ID = su.ID JOIN SYS_ORG so ON su.ORG_ID = so.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
